quote: Then here's what I'd say," he went on, brisker now, the matter of my soul apparently concluded to his satisfaction. "It's full dark, and nothing worth buying ever looks like much at dusk. If you still want it by noon, we'll go find Penworth's man and make an honest tangle of paperwork out of it, and I'll have sold my grandmother's hill to someone she'd have approved of, which is the most I've hoped for out of this business from the start."
